title: Survivor Man
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, Michael feels left out after not being invited to a wilderness retreat with branch managers, prompting him to embark on a solo survival camping trip with minimal supplies. Meanwhile, the office debates consolidating multiple birthday parties into one shared celebration, causing some conflict among coworkers. Dwight secretly stays close to Michael during his survival challenge to provide unseen support, and Michael's wilderness adventure includes attempts at survival skills such as making a spear and eating wild mushrooms despite warnings. The episode ends with uncertainties about the outcomes of Michael's trip and the communal birthday party plan.
